text: A strongly nonlinear tanh reservoir with large input scaling achieves a HIGHER linear memory capacity than the equivalent linear reservoir.
explanation: False: the linear reservoir attains the maximum MC = N, whereas nonlinearity trades linear memory away for nonlinear computation. Driving tanh into saturation with large inputs spends the fixed capacity budget on nonlinear (degree >= 2) terms and lowers linear MC, so it cannot exceed the linear case.
